scope: Exact reproduction of immutable original relative-parent source searches on all genuine native-terminal prefixes. Keep original actual visits, acting moves, reveal histories, records and native returns; derive separate targets using the unchanged upstream heuristic. No new trajectories, clairvoyant actions, forced-playout search or promotion.
limitations: Every admitted prefix must reproduce original completed root-count vectors, chosen moves, observer records and real reveals exactly. Any mismatch aborts; no replacement roots/seeds or invented original statistics.
Original source visit arrays remain immutable. Pruned targets are separate numeric arrays, with support contained in actual visited actions.
Native-prefix return labels and entire episode roles stay unchanged; the future learning control changes only normalized policy targets.

Original search uses approximate source-rule future dynamics, sampled hidden worlds and no forced playouts. Upstream pruning is a KataGo-inspired heuristic, not exact noise removal or a policy-improvement guarantee.
The preceding32-root teacher proxy is TRAIN-only and justifies one controlled learning experiment, not a strength claim. No teacher scores are fitted by this transform.
